g.text: Theorem andb_true_elim2 : forall b c : bool, andb b c = true -> c = true.Proof. intros b c H. destruct b. - simpl in H. rewrite -> H. reflexivity. - simpl in H. destruct c. + reflexivity. + rewrite -> H. reflexivity.Qed.

If b = true, simpl in H gives exactly c = true.If b = false, H becomes false = true.In the c = false branch, rewriting H turns the goal into true = true.A contradictory assumption can be used with the tactics already learned.
